evidence: After reset, all extensions disabled. Default signal path: samples → trackGain(1.0) → channelFader(0.8) → channelPan(0) → mixBus(1.0) → masterTrim(1.0) → masterGain(0.8). Net gain for single track: 0.8 × 0.8 = 0.64 (-3.88 dBFS). Even with all 9 tracks at peak, summed gain = 9 × 0.64 = 5.76 → peak_dbfs = 20*log10(5.76) = 15.2 dBFS theoretical max. But default song has only kick pattern (1 track active), so peak = -3.88 dBFS. With 4 tracks playing simultaneously, peak ~ -1.94 dBFS. All below 0 dBFS.
